input: Search the web for "summer childcare" and school-age summer care for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania and Polk counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: Boys Girls Club Henderson County summer program 2026

candidates.name: Henderson County Public Schools
candidates.note: Summer PLUS provides all-day childcare during summer break at selected elementary-school sites.

candidates.name: Henderson County Family YMCA
candidates.note: 2026 summer day care includes age-group camps for children and teens, starting at age 5.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Henderson County Adventure Camp serves ages 9–15, with care from 7:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greater Spartanburg
candidates.note: Polk County YMCA runs full-day summer childcare with swimming, crafts, sports and field trips.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: School-age and teen summer day programs; documented summer 2026 attendance reached 500 youth.

candidates.name: The Cindy Platt Boys & Girls Club of Transylvania County
candidates.note: Supervised summer programs for children and teens operated in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: Seven-week day camp for ages 4–10, plus Roots Crew counselor-in-training opportunities for rising middle schoolers.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures ran July 20–24, 2026, for rising first through seventh graders.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: United Methodist camp offering summer day and resident programs for boys and girls; 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Runs Kanuga Day Camp and Camp Bob, an outreach summer camp for youth unable to afford camp.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight sessions announced for summer 2027, ranging from six days to four weeks.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Christian girls’ overnight summer camp for grades 2–11; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp for Girls
candidates.note: Sleepaway summer camp for girls ages 6–16; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ and girls’ summer camp with farm, wilderness and traditional camp programs.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish coed sleepaway camp for ages 6–16; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Summer music training includes teen students ages 14 and up; 2027 Jazz Institute dates announced.
